analogy.name: Finding a word in a dictionary
analogy.line: Knowing the exact page is O(1). Opening the middle and halving is O(log n). Reading every word is O(n). Comparing every word with every other is O(n²).

analogy.name: Email: drafts, outbox, sent
analogy.line: Working tree is your drafts, staging is the outbox, a commit is in your sent folder, and push delivers it to everyone else's inbox (the remote).

analogy.name: Building a car
analogy.line: Test each part on the bench (unit), then the engine with the gearbox (integration), then one test drive (end to end). Lots of bench tests, few test drives.

analogy.name: Calling someone from your contacts
analogy.line: The contacts list gives the number (DNS), the call connects (TCP), you check the server is who it claims to be and agree on encryption (TLS), then exchange messages (HTTP).
